title: Number Symbols and Names to 10
seo_title: Grade R Numbers to 10 Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_code: Grade R: Number symbols and number names
standard_text: Recognise, identify and read number symbols 1 to 10 (and 0); know number names in context; say which number comes before, after or between.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade R maths worksheets: number symbols and names 0 to 10, before, after and between. 100 questions with pictures and memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Each number has a symbol (7) and a name (seven).
  • 0 (naught) means none.
  • After means one more: after 4 comes 5.
  • Before means one less: before 4 comes 3.

Examples

Example

What comes after 6?

6, 7

Answer: 7

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
6 and 96 has its loop at the bottom.
Before or afterAfter is the next number.
NamesSay the number name out loud.

faq.a: The Reception Year, the year before Grade 1 and the first year of the Foundation Phase. Learners are about 5 to 6 years old.

faq.q: Which numbers do Grade R learners read?
faq.a: Number symbols and names from 1 to 10, and 0 in Term 4.

faq.q: Do they have to write the numbers?
faq.a: They start to write number symbols; reading and matching come first.
